name: Emblem and badge
summary: A closed shape, a circle, a shield or a roundel, that holds a symbol and the name on a ring or a band. Agencies, clubs, transport lines and makers use it as a seal of membership or of origin.

philosophy.core_thesis: A mark that is a closed seal says membership and authority: the frame tells the viewer that everything inside belongs together.
design_principles: Close the mark in one shape: a circle, a shield or a rounded rectangle; the frame is 4–10% of the mark width.
Set the name on an outer ring of text at 10–14% of the diameter, or on a straight band across the centre.
Put one central symbol at 40–60% of the inner area: a star, an animal, a tool or a vector arrow.
Use 2–4 flat colours, and give the outer ring a dark colour that holds the shape on any ground.
Make the mark work at 32 px as a solid disc with the central symbol, even if the ring text no longer reads.
Keep the mark symmetric on the vertical axis, except one dynamic element such as a swoosh or an orbit.
anti_patterns: An open composition with no frame
Text on the ring smaller than 6% of the diameter
Two competing symbols inside the frame

construction.grid: Concentric circles: the outer edge, the ring for text and the inner field, at radii of about 100%, 85% and 70%.
construction.geometry: Circles and arcs from a compass, straight bands, and stars or shields from regular polygons.
construction.stroke_rule: Frame and ring lines at 2–5% of the diameter; symbol strokes at 4–8%.
construction.symmetry: Mirror symmetry on the vertical axis; one diagonal element may break it.
construction.detail_floor: No gap or stroke under 1.5% of the diameter, so the badge survives embroidery and stamping.

form.silhouette: A circle at 1:1, a shield near 5:6, or a horizontal oval near 4:3.
form.ornament: Stars, laurel, a rope or dot ring, and a banner; flat, with no hatching.
form.letterforms: Bold sans-serif or slab capitals, set on the arc with a tracking of 5–15%; the top text reads clockwise and the bottom text reads anticlockwise.

colour.strategy: A dark navy or green field, one strong red or gold accent, and white for text and the symbol.
colour.reversal_rule: The closed shape reverses as a solid disc; the symbol and the text become knock-outs of the ground.

reproduction.media: Embroidered patches, enamel pins, stamps, decals, vehicle livery and screen.

emotion.target_response: Belonging and authority: the viewer sees an official seal and reads the mark as a member, a team or an agency.

avoid_when: The mark must fit a narrow horizontal slot, such as a 6:1 header.
The brief asks for a light, quiet or luxury tone.

modifiers.how: Keep the central symbol and the flat colour; drop the ring text and the frame, and let the symbol stand alone.
Keep the closed frame; add engraved hatching, a banner and a second typeface.
